verdict.rationale: A secure client portal or extranet is a fair question for a large law firm, so the axis applies. However, no cited page documents a client-facing portal for matters, documents or status. The Legaltech & ALS page covers internal AI/ML contract review and the Prarambh incubator, not a client extranet, and the Advanced Delivery page has no captured content describing one.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm offers a secure client portal or extranet for matters, documents, and status, documented on its own pages
